# External fixture qualification evidence

These JSON records are source qualification evidence generated by the
checksum-locked registry in `fixtures/external/manifest.json`. They prove that
the selected downloads matched their registered byte lengths and SHA-256
digests and that their STEP Part 21 envelopes could be inspected completely.
They are not renderer benchmarks.

| Record | Selected files | Source bytes | Part 21 entities |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `nist-pmi-step-files.json` | 2 members from the official ZIP | 4,065,743 | 30,100 |
| `ifc-bench-digital-hub.json` | 4 discipline IFC files | 67,829,367 | 482,994 |

Reproduce after explicitly fetching the corresponding source:

```sh
pnpm fixtures:external inspect nist-pmi-step-files \
  --output artifacts/fixtures/external/nist-pmi-step-files.json
pnpm fixtures:external inspect ifc-bench-digital-hub \
  --output artifacts/fixtures/external/ifc-bench-digital-hub.json
pnpm fixtures:external:check
```

The records include the manifest SHA-256. Changing a URL, source revision,
license identity, expected size, or checksum invalidates the committed evidence
until qualification is deliberately rerun.
